name: Shingari Miroku
source:
He hates to lose and is very picky, and once he decides something, he sticks to it stoically. He speaks calmly and maturely despite being the youngest member of the group, but he sometimes shows an expression appropriate for his age.

He is unsatisfied with KiLLER KiNG's situation and is getting impatient.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#shingarimiroku]offiical website[/url]]
